title: Software Engineer (AI)
description:
**Role Overview**
-----------------

We are looking for an **AI Engineer — GenAI, RAG & Backend** with 3–4 years of software engineering experience and hands-on exposure to **Generative AI, LLM applications, RAG, APIs, and AI-agent workflows**.

The candidate will work closely with the **Senior AI/ML Engineer and AI Architect** to develop, integrate, test, and deploy enterprise-grade AI applications.

The ideal candidate should have a strong foundation in **Python backend development** and practical knowledge of modern GenAI technologies.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Develop and maintain **Generative AI applications** using Python and LLM APIs.
* Build and enhance **RAG pipelines** using embeddings, vector databases, retrieval, and contextual generation.
* Develop backend services and APIs using **Python, FastAPI, and REST APIs**.
* Integrate LLM providers such as **OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini**.
* Implement prompt engineering techniques for reliable and consistent LLM responses.
* Develop basic **AI-agent and tool-calling workflows** under the guidance of senior engineers.
* Work with vector databases for semantic search and knowledge retrieval.
* Design and implement database integrations using **PostgreSQL**.
* Write reusable, maintainable, and well-tested Python code.
* Containerize applications using **Docker** and support cloud deployment.
* Troubleshoot API, LLM, RAG, and application-level issues.
* Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, testing, and documentation.
* Work with the Senior Engineer and AI Architect to implement technical designs and AI workflows.
* Perform POCs and evaluate new GenAI technologies when required.
* Monitor and improve application performance, reliability, response quality, and LLM usage costs.

**Must-Have Skills**
--------------------

### **Programming & Backend**

* **Python** — strong hands-on experience
* **FastAPI**
* REST API development
* Experience developing backend applications
* Understanding of API authentication, error handling, and integration

### **Generative AI & LLM**

* Understanding of **Generative AI and LLMs**
* Experience working with **LLM APIs**
* Prompt engineering
* Understanding of tokens, context windows, temperature, embeddings, etc.
* Experience with one or more LLM providers such as:
  + OpenAI
  + Azure OpenAI
  + Anthropic
  + Google Gemini

### **RAG & Vector Search**

* Practical experience with **Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)**
* Embeddings
* Semantic search
* Vector databases
* Document ingestion and chunking
* Retrieval and context construction
* Basic understanding of RAG quality and hallucination issues

### **Database & Development Tools**

* **PostgreSQL**
* Git / GitHub / Azure Repos
* **Docker**
* Basic Azure or AWS experience

**Preferred Skills**
--------------------

Candidates with exposure to the following will be preferred:

* **LangChain**
* **LangGraph**
* **Neo4j / GraphRAG**
* **Model Context Protocol (MCP)**
* Ollama
* Open-source LLMs
* Azure OpenAI
* React / Next.js
* Redis
* CI/CD
* Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions
* Basic understanding of LLM evaluation and AI guardrails

**Technical Expectations**
--------------------------

The candidate should be able to independently handle tasks such as:

* Creating a FastAPI service for an LLM application.
* Integrating an LLM API into an existing application.
* Building a basic RAG pipeline from document ingestion to response generation.
* Creating embeddings and storing/searching them in a vector database.
* Implementing prompt templates and structured LLM responses.
* Building basic tool-calling or agent workflows.
* Connecting AI services with PostgreSQL and other backend systems.
* Dockerizing a Python application.
* Debugging API and LLM integration issues.
* Writing unit tests and maintaining clean Git-based development practices.

**What We Are Looking For**
---------------------------

* Strong software development fundamentals with practical Python experience.
* Genuine hands-on experience building **GenAI applications**, not just theoretical knowledge.
* Good understanding of RAG concepts and LLM application patterns.
* Ability to learn new AI frameworks and technologies quickly.
* Good debugging and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work effectively under the guidance of a Senior Engineer and AI Architect.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.
* Willingness to work on both **AI/ML and backend engineering** tasks.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Saleshandy)
description:
**Experience:** 5-7 years

**About Saleshandy**
--------------------

Saleshandy is how thousands of sales teams around the world find their next customer and reach them. A lead database of **850+ million contacts**. Email sequences and mailbox warmup running continuously across tens of thousands of inboxes. Analytics that has to be correct the moment someone looks at it.

Every one of those is a systems problem before it's a product problem, and that's where the interesting work is. Searching hundreds of millions of records in under a second. Processing event streams that can't lose or double-count a message. Building interfaces that stay fast when the dataset behind them only ever grows.

We're hiring a Tech Lead to own a significant part of that surface, and the engineers who build it.

**What's the Role About**
-------------------------

You'll lead a team of engineers working across the stack, and you'll still be one of the **strongest engineers** on it. You take the hardest problem of the quarter yourself, you're in the design reviews catching what everyone else missed, and you own the architectural direction for everything your team touches.

You'll also own something less visible and worth more: that there is **one right way** to do the things that have to be correct. One approach to retries and failure recovery. One source of truth for the numbers customers see. Defined once and inherited, instead of five engineers each arriving at a slightly different, slightly wrong version of it.

Three things matter more than the title you held before:

* **Technical direction.** You can hold the whole system in your head and say where it's going. You make the call between queue and stream, between a new service and a boundary in an existing one, and you can defend it on trade-offs rather than preference.
* **Force multiplication.** Your result isn't what you shipped, it's what the team shipped and how much better they got doing it. You know where every engineer stands, you deal with a performance problem when you see it rather than when the calendar says to, and you're the reason the strong ones stay and people grows.
* **High agency.** You act when the spec is unclear instead of waiting for someone to decide for you. Work doesn't stall on your side waiting on another team, you go and unblock it. You stay on the hook for what you ship until it actually works in production, not until it's merged.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own the architectural direction across your surfaces, and the trade-offs behind every call
* Design and ship the hardest work yourself, you stay a builder
* Run design reviews that catch races, partial failures, and everything that only breaks at volume
* Define the shared patterns your team inherits, and consolidate the ones that got built twice
* Own operability: what you ship is observable, alerted, and runnable by more than one person
* Grow the engineers on your team, and give leadership an honest, evidence-backed read on each of them
* Run interview loops and make the call on who joins
* Own a customer-facing metric, and cut the work that isn't moving it
* Use AI coding agents as a core part of the workflow, and own the quality bar that keeps their output honest

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* **Distributed systems experience that's real.** Services that stay correct when they fail halfway and get retried. Event pipelines that don't lose or duplicate work. You can defend your choice of queue, stream, or store instead of reaching for whichever is fashionable.
* **Data at volume.** MySQL that holds up under genuine load, schema, indexing, and finding the query that's quietly costing you. Search and analytics at scale with OpenSearch or ClickHouse. Caching as a deliberate decision, not a reflex.
* **Credibility across the stack.** You review a data-heavy React surface's state architecture as seriously as you review a service boundary. You don't need to out-build your specialists; you do need to recognise the design that will hurt in six months.
* **You can run what you ship.** Containerised deploys, CI/CD, and production observability. When something is intermittently timing out, you find it in traces and metrics rather than guessing.
* **AI fluency with judgment.** You use coding agents daily, and you've thought about what breaks when an entire team does and put something in place for it.
* **A track record with people.** Engineers you've led who got measurably better, and who you can talk about specifically.

**Our stack****:** Node.js, TypeScript, MySQL, Redis, Kafka, OpenSearch, React, Docker, AWS, Grafana/Tempo/Loki.

**Nice to have, not required:** ClickHouse, MongoDB, Terraform. You'll pick these up here if you haven't used them.  
https://stackshare.io/saleshandy/saleshandy

**Why Join Us**
---------------

* **Purpose:** You'll own a core part of a product used every working day by thousands of sales teams, at a scale, 850 million records, continuous delivery infrastructure, real-time analytics, you can't get at most companies.
* **Growth:** This is the seat that leads to Staff Engineer or Engineering Manager here, depending on which half of it you find you love. You'll find out which one you are.
* **Leverage:** We're serious about AI-first engineering. You'll set how an entire team works with coding agents, not just how you do.
* **Ownership:** Architectural direction, a customer metric, and the team. Not a ticket-routing role with a senior title.

**Culture Fit, Are You One of Us**
----------------------------------

* You still write code :)
* You use AI as a multiplier.
* You don't wait for permission on the calls you can reverse, you make them, write down why, and keep moving.
* You get genuine satisfaction out of someone else levelling up.
* You'll tell someone their design is wrong, or that they aren't growing, in a way they can actually hear.
* You raise a "yellow" early, and you thank the people who do the same.
* You debug with traces, logs, and metrics, never with guesswork.
* You'd rather define the right pattern once than personally fix the same bug five times.

title: Principal Software Engineer – Java
description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for a technically strong, hands-on Java Principal Software Engineer with extensive experience in modern

Java, Spring Boot, microservices, cloud architecture, and database design.

The candidate will actively contribute to technical design, coding, code reviews, troubleshooting, and feature implementation while providing technical guidance and mentorship to developers.

The Principal Software Engineer will work closely with the Solution/Technical Architect to translate architectural designs into practical implementations, align development decisions with architectural standards, and ensure solutions are scalable, secure, maintainable, and performant.

The ideal candidate should have strong engineering fundamentals, practical experience with AI-assisted development tools, and a humble, collaborative attitude with a genuine willingness to learn.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the design, development, and implementation of backend features using modern Java, Spring Boot, and microservices.
* Collaborate with the Solution/Technical Architect to understand architectural decisions, translate designs into implementation plans, and provide technical feedback on feasibility, complexity, and trade-offs.
* Ensure implementation aligns with agreed architecture, design principles, security standards, and engineering best practices.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, and design gaps, and work with the Architect to resolve them.
* Design maintainable, scalable solutions using appropriate design patterns, SOLID principles, and clean coding practices.
* Develop and review REST APIs following established standards for resource naming, HTTP methods, status codes, request validation, error handling, versioning, and pagination.
* Design, implement, and troubleshoot scheduled and background jobs, including job execution, scheduling, failure handling, and recovery.
* Collaborate with developers on technical implementation, code reviews, problem-solving, and features Delivery.
* Design and review database schemas, relationships, indexes, SQL queries, transactions, and database migration strategies.
* Understand cloud architecture, including API gateways, load balancers, networking, compute services, managed databases, security, and monitoring.
* Implement application security measures, including authentication, authorization, JWT validation, and secure service-to-service communication.
* Apply performance optimization techniques, including caching, rate limiting, database query optimization, and efficient resource utilization.
* Leverage AI-assisted development tools to accelerate coding, debugging, refactoring, test creation, and documentation while maintaining code quality and security.
* Troubleshoot complex applications, database, networking, performance, and production issues.
* Guide and mentor developers, establish coding standards, and ensure maintainable, reliable, secure, and scalable solutions.
* Coordinate technical dependencies, manage delivery risks, and collaborate with QA, DevOps, and other Teams.

**Required Skills**

* **Modern Java**: Strong knowledge of Java 17+, collections, HashMap internals, generics, concurrency, multithreading, synchronization, JVM fundamentals, object-oriented programming, and SOLID principles.
* **Data Structures and Algorithms**: Understanding of fundamental data structures and algorithms, including arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, hash maps, trees, sorting, and searching. Familiarity with time and space complexity (Big O notation), algorithmic efficiency, and selecting appropriate approaches to solve practical engineering problems.
* **Spring Boot**: Strong understanding of dependency injection, bean lifecycle, transaction management, REST APIs, exception handling, and Spring Security.
* **REST API Standards**: Understanding of REST principles, resource-oriented design, HTTP methods and status codes, request validation, consistent error responses, API versioning, pagination, filtering, and backward compatibility.
* **Design Patterns and Clean Code**: Practical knowledge of commonly used design patterns such as Factory, Strategy, Builder, Observer, and Singleton, with the ability to select appropriate patterns without unnecessary complexity. Strong understanding of SOLID principles, separation of concerns, and maintainable code design.
* **Microservices**: Experience designing and troubleshooting distributed applications, service communication, resilience, and data consistency.
* **Cloud Architecture**: Good understanding of cloud components, networking, API gateways, load balancing, security, deployment, and monitoring. Experience with Azure, AWS, or GCP.
* **Database Design**: Ability to design relational database schemas, write and optimize SQL queries, understand indexing and transactions and manage schema changes.
* **Networking and Security**: Working knowledge of HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, TCP/IP, TLS, JWT, and secure API communication.
* **Performance and Scalability**: Understanding of caching strategies, cache invalidation, rate limiting, throttling, database optimization, and application performance tuning.
* **Messaging Systems**: Working knowledge of messaging systems such as Apache Kafka, Azure Service Bus, or similar technologies, including asynchronous communication and message processing.
* **Job Scheduling**: Working knowledge of Quartz Scheduler or similar scheduling frameworks, including cron expressions, job and trigger configuration, execution lifecycle, misfire handling, failure recovery, and preventing duplicate or overlapping job execution where required.
* **AI-Assisted Development**: Practical experience with AI coding tools such as Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar platforms. Ability to write effective prompts, provide relevant codebase context, use AI for code generation, debugging, refactoring, and test creation, and critically review AI-generated code for correctness, security, performance, and maintainability.
* **Technical Leadership and Architecture Collaboration**: Ability to work effectively with the Solution/Technical Architect, understand and implement architectural decisions, discuss technical tradeoffs, raise design concerns, and provide feedback based on implementation experience. title: AI Solutions Architect / Lead Developer
description:
**Experience:** 4\-8 Years
**Vacancy:** 1
**Type:** Full Time
**Job Location:** Gandhinagar


We are seeking a highly skilled AI Solutions Architect / Lead Developer who can both architect and build enterprise\-grade AI solutions. This is a hands\-on role requiring deep technical expertise in Generative AI, Microsoft AI technologies, application development, automation, and data analytics.


The ideal candidate will have experience designing and implementing AI\-powered applications, intelligent agents, workflow automation solutions, and business productivity tools leveraging Azure OpenAI, Copilot technologies, and Microsoft Power Platform. The candidate should be capable of independently taking solutions from concept to deployment.


**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------


**AI Solution Architecture \& Development**


* Design, develop, and deploy enterprise AI solutions using Azure OpenAI and OpenAI APIs.
* Architect and implement Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions.
* Build AI agents and multi\-agent workflows for business use cases.
* Develop prompt engineering frameworks and reusable AI components.
* Design secure, scalable, and production\-ready AI applications.
* Integrate LLMs with enterprise data sources and business applications.
* Implement monitoring, evaluation, and optimization strategies for AI solutions.


**Microsoft AI \& Copilot Ecosystem**


* Build custom solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio.
* Develop Copilot extensions, plugins, and custom actions.
* Leverage Azure AI Foundry for AI application development and deployment.
* Integrate AI solutions with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, and Dynamics environments.
* Utilize Microsoft Graph APIs to connect enterprise systems and data.


**Application Development**


* Develop backend services using Python.
* Design and consume REST APIs.
* Build AI\-powered web applications and automation tools.
* Develop integrations using JSON\-based APIs and cloud services.
* Create lightweight front\-end interfaces using JavaScript where required.


**Automation \& Productivity Solutions**


* Develop Excel\-based AI tools and add\-ins.
* Automate business workflows using Power Automate.
* Build low\-code applications using Power Apps.
* Create Office Scripts and Excel automation solutions.
* Design end\-to\-end automation workflows for finance, operations, and compliance functions.


**Data Engineering \& Analytics**


* Build data processing pipelines using Python and Pandas.
* Design and maintain data models and database schemas.
* Develop dashboards and insights using Power BI.
* Perform structured and unstructured data analysis.
* Optimize solutions for performance, scalability, and usability.

**Required Technical Skills****:**
----------------------------------


**AI \& Generative AI**


Must have hands\-on experience with:


* Azure OpenAI Services, OpenAI APIs, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Prompt Engineering, Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Agent Development, LLM Application Development, Vector Databases and Semantic Search, AI Governance and Responsible AI practices


**Programming \& Development**


* Advanced Python development, SQL and database querying, REST API development and integration, JSON data structures and API payload design, JavaScript (Basic to Intermediate), Git Version Control, Object\-Oriented Programming principles


**Microsoft Ecosystem**


* Excel Automation, Office Scripts, Power Automate, Power Apps, Microsoft Graph API, Microsoft 365 Integrations, Copilot Extensibility, SharePoint Online Integrations


**Data \& Analytics**


* Pandas, Power BI, Data Modelling, Database Design, Data Transformation, Business Intelligence Reporting

**Required Experience****:**
----------------------------


* 4\-8 years of software development, automation, or solution architecture experience.
* Minimum 2\+ years of hands\-on experience in Generative AI solution development.
* Experience deploying AI solutions in Azure environments.
* Experience integrating enterprise systems using APIs.
* Proven experience developing automation and productivity solutions within the Microsoft ecosystem.
* Experience working with structured and unstructured business data.

**Preferred Experience****:**
-----------------------------


Experience building solutions such as:


* Excel add\-ins integrated with Azure OpenAI
* AI\-powered financial analysis tools
* Valuation modelling assistants built using Python and LLMs
* Financial statement extraction and processing tools
* Automated report review and summarization agents
* Contract review and compliance agents
* Knowledge management and enterprise search solutions
* Copilot\-based business productivity assistants
* Workflow automation solutions powered by AI agents

**Soft Skills****:**
--------------------


* Strong solution architecture mindset
* Ability to translate business problems into AI\-powered solutions
* Excellent stakeholder communication skills
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities
* Self\-driven and capable of independently delivering projects
* Ability to mentor junior developers and lead technical discussions

**Success Criteria****:**
-------------------------


The successful candidate should be able to:


* Independently design and build production\-ready AI solutions.
* Develop and deploy RAG\-based applications and AI agents.
* Create Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform, and Azure AI solutions.
* Deliver end\-to\-end solutions from architecture through deployment.
* Build practical business applications that generate measurable productivity and efficiency gains.


**Ideal Profile:** A hands\-on AI engineer who combines the capabilities of a Solution Architect, AI Developer, Automation Specialist, and Microsoft Platform Expert, with the ability to build real\-world business solutions rather than only designing them.
